FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Trophy & Awards Emporium, our core operations focus on the retail production and sale of a diverse range of awards, trophies, and recognition items. We specialize in providing high-quality engraved trophies and custom awards tailored to individual client specifications while ensuring a strict adherence to quality control processes to minimize defects. Our operations include in-house engraving and personalizations using state-of-the-art laser engraving technology and CNC machines, which undergo regular maintenance and inspections to uphold our commitment to equipment reliability.

We maintain a secure inventory management system for both raw materials and finished products, employing strict controls to prevent loss and ensure accurate tracking. Furthermore, our high-value items are stored in secure, lockable areas to mitigate risks of theft and vandalism. Each of our subcontracted engraving projects is handled by vetted professionals who are required to have current insurance, allowing us to mitigate liability risks associated with outsourced work.

Trophy & Awards Emporium operates with an emphasis on customer service excellence, offering dedicated support for custom orders and inquiries. We also implement secure shipping procedures to safeguard all shipments, ensuring timely and accurate delivery to our customers. Through ongoing training programs, we equip our staff with the necessary skills to operate machinery safely, complying with all standards to foster a safe working environment.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 5, 2022, a theft incident occurred at our location, resulting in the loss of several high-value trophies and awards. This incident was promptly reported to the local police and our insurance company. The estimated total amount of the loss was $1,500.00. The case is currently under investigation, and we are in the process of implementing enhanced security measures to prevent future occurrences.
